criteria.requirement: Implement tinydb.atomic.AtomicJSONStorage(Storage) with TinyDB-compatible read/write/close and constructor (path, *, create_dirs=False, encoding="utf-8", **json_options). Serialize completely before opening a same-directory temporary file, flush/fsync and atomically os.replace; preserve existing mode, use 0600 for new files, clean temporary files and retain old bytes on serialization/write/replace failure. Read current path each time, return None for absent/empty files, reject nonmapping JSON roots and symlink targets, and reject reads/writes after close. Verify reopen and shrinking data. Preserve existing JSONStorage and do not claim cross-process locking, hostile-directory race protection or parent-directory crash durability.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
